name: Betsi Cadwaladr UHB — child neurodevelopmental assessment
description: Local NHS Wales Neurodevelopmental Service information describing holistic assessment for children and young people who may have a neurodevelopmental condition, including information gathered across home, education and health contexts.
intended_use: Inspect one current Welsh health-board child neurodevelopmental assessment model while keeping referral and age rules explicitly local.
audience_or_context: Children and young people, parents/carers, schools and supporters in the Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board area.
limitations: This is a Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board pathway and does not establish referral rules for all Welsh health boards.
The page describes assessment of strengths and needs and possible neurodevelopmental diagnosis; individual assessment content varies.
Local age boundaries and referral processes require current checking.
cost_or_access_notes: NHS access depends on current local catchment, referral and eligibility arrangements.
conflicts_of_interest: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board describes a service it provides; ND Oracle records the local route without generalising it to Wales as a whole.

provenance.method: Current Betsi Cadwaladr Neurodevelopmental Service assessment page checked on 2026-09-03 for holistic assessment, multi-setting information and local-service scope. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
